title: The easiest way to make croissant! Why I didn't know this method before!

items: 1 tbsp dry yeast or instant yeast (8g)

steps.text: Mix 1/3 cup of warm water, 1 tbsp sugar, and 1 tbsp dry yeast or instant yeast.
Leave the mixture for 5 to 10 minutes.
Mix 1/5 cup of warm milk, 2/3 tsp salt, and the previous mixture.
Add 2 cups flour and 5 tbsp soft butter to the mixture and mix the dough by hand.
Knead the dough by hand for 6 minutes.
Let the dough rest at room temperature for 1 hour until it doubles in size.
Transfer the dough to a well-floured surface and divide it into 8 equal portions.
Take one piece and form a ball, then roll out the dough into a circle and transfer it to a well-floured dish.
Grease the dough circle with soft butter, then put on top another circle of dough and grease it with soft butter.
Put on top another circle of dough again with grease, then chill in the fridge for one hour.
Transfer the dough to a well-floured surface and roll out the dough into a large rectangle.
Trim the edges and slice the large rectangle into 6 triangles.
Cut a small slit at the wide end of each triangle, then tightly roll up each triangle to form croissants.
Transfer the croissants to a baking sheet and let them rest at room temperature for 1 hour.
Bake the croissants at 190°C (375°F) for 20-25 minutes.
